theme: 3 SwiftUI tools for long text, web links and links that open your app

terms.definition: A view that lets people type and edit many lines of text.
terms.example: Use a TextEditor for the note body.

terms.definition: A view that opens a web address when a person taps it.
terms.example: Add a Link to the help page.
terms.code:
let url = URL(string: "https://apple.com")!
Link("Docs", destination: url)

terms.definition: A modifier that runs code when your app is opened with a link.
terms.example: Read the link in onOpenURL, then show the right screen.

video.title: TextEditor, Link & onOpenURL | Day 172
video.description:
Learn to explain how to edit text, open links and handle incoming links in SwiftUI: TextEditor, Link & onOpenURL, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
TextEditor - A view that lets people type and edit many lines of text.
Link - A view that opens a web address when a person taps it.
onOpenURL - A modifier that runs code when your app is opened with a link.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 172 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: SwiftUI TextEditor, Link & onOpenURL | Day 172
landscape.description:
Explain TextEditor, Link & onOpenURL in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
텍스트에디터, 링크, 온오픈유알엘 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

TextEditor - A view that lets people type and edit many lines of text.
한국어: 텍스트에디터: 여러 줄의 글을 입력하고 고칠 수 있게 하는 뷰

Link - A view that opens a web address when a person taps it.
한국어: 링크: 탭하면 웹 주소를 여는 뷰

onOpenURL - A modifier that runs code when your app is opened with a link.
한국어: 온오픈유알엘: 링크로 앱이 열릴 때 코드를 실행하는 모디파이어

In this video, Mina and Jake build a notes screen with long text and links, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain TextEditor, Link and onOpenURL in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my notes screen needs a big place to write.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a TextEditor. It lets people type many lines.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I bind the TextEditor to my `text`?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, pass `$text`, and the note saves as the user types.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I also want a help button that opens a website.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a Link with a `url`. Tap the Link, and Safari opens.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I wrote a Button and opened the page by hand.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A Link is simpler, and it is the right view for web pages.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Now, other apps send a link to my app. How do I read it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add onOpenURL to the root view.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So onOpenURL gives me the `url` when the app opens?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Then check the path and show the matching note.
Use a TextEditor for long notes.
